The Windows 10 display settings allow you to change the appearance of your desktop and customize it to your liking. There are many different display settings you can adjust, from adjusting the brightness of your screen to choosing the size of text and icons on your monitor. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to adjust your Windows 10 display settings.

1. Find the Start button located at the bottom left corner of your screen. Click on the Start button and then select Settings.

2. In the Settings window, click on System.

3. On the left side of the window, click on Display. This will open up the display settings options.

4. You can adjust the brightness of your screen by using the slider located at the top of the page. You can also change the scaling of your screen by selecting one of the preset sizes or manually adjusting the slider.

5. To adjust the size of text and icons on your monitor, scroll down to the Scale and layout section. Here you can choose between the recommended size and manually entering a custom size. Once you have chosen the size you would like, click the Apply button to save your changes.

6. You can also adjust the orientation of your display by clicking the dropdown menu located under Orientation. You have the options to choose between landscape, portrait, and rotated.

7. Next, scroll down to the Multiple displays section. Here you can choose to extend your display or duplicate it onto another monitor.

8. Finally, scroll down to the Advanced display settings section. Here you can find more advanced display settings such as resolution and color depth.

By making these adjustments to your Windows 10 display settings, you can customize your desktop to fit your personal preference. Additionally, these settings can help improve the clarity of your monitor for a better viewing experience.

Top DJ Charts of the Past: A Look Back at Purely Silk’s Best Moments in 2018

As our company soon eclipses 20 years in the DJ software business we take a look back at our accomplishments in 2018.

There’s no “I” in “Team”, but there are three “I’s” in “Digital 1 Audio” (One more if you add the “Inc.”). Our tight group of individuals, each with their own unique set of skills, form one heck of a team that’s not only stood up to the test of time (20 years baby!), but has continued to pursue greatness with unwavering passion.

This is it. This is what we do, and what we get up early every morning and burn the midnight oil for. We strive to create innovative and disruptive DJ and live performance technology that makes your life easier and events more memorable. I honestly couldn’t imagine doing anything else.

It’s been a great year for new product releases, upgrades to existing products, and business in general. We fully understand that you’re the reason we’re here and we sincerely thank you. Those customers that have been championing our products by spreading the word and sending in referrals, you’re superstars in our eye’s. We truly can’t think you enough.

At the conclusion of each year we take a look back at he milestones and accomplishments attained for our DJ software and karaoke software lineup. Here’s how 2018 went for PCDJ:

If you click on a link and make a purchase, I may receive a commission at no extra cost to you.

2018 PCDJ Milestones

  • Upgraded and released versions 3.10 through 3.12.0.3 of DEX 3 (and DEX 3 RE )
  • Completely redesigned our DJ DEX iPad app for iOS and released it in the App Store for only $4.99 .
  • Introduced support in DEX 3 for on-screen, beat-aware visualizations with “Shaders “.
  • Spent considerable development effort to introduce a slew of professional-level karaoke features to DEX 3, making it the most robust ‘do-it-all’ solution available for DJs and/or KJs.
  • Added a Karaoke Singer Rotation list (managed singer rotation) in LYRX and DEX 3.
  • Added singer/song history (singer management) to DEX 3 and LYRX
  • Added automatic filler music player feature to both DEX 3 and LYRX
  • DEX 3 and LYRX in-app support for the new Karaoke.net store , allowing karaoke hosts and DJs to make on-the-fly purchases of karaoke songs from within the software browser.
  • Many new improvements to scripting for DJ controllers, allowing for better overall plug-and-play support for the best DJ controller s on the market.
  • Added plug-and-play support for the Pioneer DDJ-SX3, Pioneer DDJ-SB3, Pioneer DDJ-SR2, Pioneer WeGo4, Reloop Mixtour, and Numark NDX500
  • Launched a new Partnership with BPM Supreme to offer PCDJ customers a free month of music and video downloads.
  • Took a walk down memory lane with Mobile Beat (editorial) and they reviewed our top DJ software DEX 3 (pro) .
  • Created a new Facebook User Group for PCDJ customers to interact and share tips/ideas.
  • Laid substantial ‘ground work’ for a plethora of new features and in-app partnerships coming in 2019.

2018 was a pretty busy year for PCDJ but 2019 is already looking to nothing short of monumental comparatively — and that’s not only because we’ll be celebrating 20 years in business. DEX 3 and DJ DEX app users can look forward to our new SoundCloud Partnership that will officially launch very early 2019. In-browser support for 190 million songs for a very affordable monthly fee? Yes, I’ll have seconds, please!

Stay tuned in for an upcoming blog post that will cover some of our goals for 2019, and beyond!

The Windows 10 display settings allow you to change the appearance of your desktop and customize it to your liking. There are many different display settings you can adjust, from adjusting the brightness of your screen to choosing the size of text and icons on your monitor. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to adjust your Windows 10 display settings.

1. Find the Start button located at the bottom left corner of your screen. Click on the Start button and then select Settings.

2. In the Settings window, click on System.

3. On the left side of the window, click on Display. This will open up the display settings options.

4. You can adjust the brightness of your screen by using the slider located at the top of the page. You can also change the scaling of your screen by selecting one of the preset sizes or manually adjusting the slider.

5. To adjust the size of text and icons on your monitor, scroll down to the Scale and layout section. Here you can choose between the recommended size and manually entering a custom size. Once you have chosen the size you would like, click the Apply button to save your changes.

6. You can also adjust the orientation of your display by clicking the dropdown menu located under Orientation. You have the options to choose between landscape, portrait, and rotated.

7. Next, scroll down to the Multiple displays section. Here you can choose to extend your display or duplicate it onto another monitor.

8. Finally, scroll down to the Advanced display settings section. Here you can find more advanced display settings such as resolution and color depth.

By making these adjustments to your Windows 10 display settings, you can customize your desktop to fit your personal preference. Additionally, these settings can help improve the clarity of your monitor for a better viewing experience.
